title: Integrating Accounts Receivable Automation with Your Existing ERP System
summary: Key Takeaways Companies automating more than half their AR processes reported a 32% drop in Days Sales Outstanding. No-code AR plug-ins add a data layer on top of a legacy ERP without a full replacement or heavy IT lift. AR automation can shave more than 20 days off DSO and cut average collection periods by up to 30%. Coca-Cola Bottlers recovered $33.4 million through deductions management, clearing disputes in an average of 34 days. Clorox automated 80% of its cash posting with an integrated cash application setup built for high invoice volumes. Collections, dunning, and recurring invoicing are the easiest pieces to integrate, with payback in days to weeks. Roughly 85% of CFOs at companies automating AR saw a measurable DSO decline. Quick Summary If you run a small SaaS on a legacy ERP, here’s the short version: accounts receivable automation integrations bolt onto what you already have and fix cash flow without ripping anything out. Connect the two systems directly, streamline collections, and you’ll see faster payments within months.
